# Julien Florkin

> > Personal development and psychology insights exploring personality traits, self-improvement, and human behavior.

Julien Florkin's website offers in-depth articles on psychology, personality frameworks like the Big Five, and practical self-improvement strategies. The content focuses on evidence-based approaches to understanding yourself and others.

## Key Topics

- Big Five Personality Traits
- Self-Improvement
- Psychology
- Personality Traits
- Self-Understanding
- Human Behavior
- Personal Development
- Openness
- Conscientiousness
- Extraversion
- Agreeableness
- Neuroticism

## Psychology and Personality

- [The Big Five Personality Traits: Understanding Yourself and Others](https://julienflorkin.com/self-improvement/the-big-five-personality-traits-understanding-yourself-and-others): Guide to Big Five personality traits and their impact on behavior
